title: PolySwarm Feed
description: Imports PolySwarm's curated file-hash threat feed into OpenCTI. By default it pulls the 14-day trust group feed over TAXII 2.1; the ransomware and freemium collections can be added. For each sample it creates the malware, the file, MD5, SHA-1 and SHA-256 indicators, one malware-analysis object per detection engine, relationships, and MITRE ATT&CK patterns where the feed provides them. Optionally it also imports hits from your own PolySwarm live hunts as files, SHA-256 indicators, notes and labels. File hashes only; no network indicators. Requires a PolySwarm account with feed access.
short_description: Import PolySwarm's curated malware file-hash feed, per-engine analysis results and optional live-hunt hits into OpenCTI.
